responsibility: Implements loop trip-count and iteration-estimation analysis for tree SSA. It analyzes affine exit conditions, refines value ranges using guarding predicates and range-query information, reasons about induction-variable overflow and wraparound, computes exact or estimated numbers of iterations and statement executions, records loop control-IV and bound metadata, and provides invalidation/substitution support so later loop transforms can maintain or discard cached niter information correctly.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual loop-iteration and trip-count analysis, including exit reasoning, overflow/wrap checks, estimates, and cached loop-info maintenance. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-niter.h, it performs the analysis and cache updates rather than only declaring the query interface.
